snippet.title: Lavender Station Trailer Reveal 2026
snippet.description:
Care for Lavender Station, a small rural train platform in this cozy train station sim. Welcome passengers, meet their needs, and shape the station’s atmosphere. Decorate and customize your platform, improve its reputation, and create a calm, charming stop for every traveler.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4446130/Lavender_Station
